issue.title: Bug: test_bbr_enabled_dut_asn_in_aspath fails to install route after using a version of cEOS >= 4.30.1

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Using a version of cEOS >= 4.30.1 the test_bbr_enabled_dut_asn_in_aspath fails because the injected route is not installed in the DUT.  In version 4.30.1, the new version of cEOS chooses to not rewrite the nexthop IP because it detects that the nexthop is in the same subnet as the DUT and thus chooses to not rewrite the nexthop because the DUT can (should?) be able to reach the nexthop directly.  Unfortunately, the test is injecting a route with the DUT's IP as the nexthop.  When the DUT sees this incoming route, it (correctly) drops the route because it would be literally trying to route back to itself.

There is a configuration parameter that can be set in cEOS which restores the previous behaviour.  In those previous versions of cEOS, the configuration would be a no-op, but in the newer cEOS, the configuration restores the previous behaviour.

### Steps to Reproduce

Use a cEOS version >= 4.30.1, and run the test_bbr_enabled_dut_asn_in_aspath test.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual: the test fails because the route does not appear on the DUT

Expected: the test passes

resolution.title: Update cEOS configuration to use next-hop-self
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: Force the cEOS instances to use their own IP for next-hop
Fixes #18658

### Type of change

- [X] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [X] 202505

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fixing a bug introduced by using a newer version of cEOS for testing.  While the current documentation doesn't specify a newer version of cEOS, it would be good to have this fix in place before people start using a newer version of cEOS.

#### How did you do it?
Adjust the cEOS configuration templates to force cEOS to rewrite the next-hop as itself

#### How did you verify/test it?
Normal sonic-mgmt test run

#### Any platform specific information?
Not platform-dependent.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
All

### Documentation
Just a bugfix.
